entries.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
entries.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest frontier model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity, agentic coding, and long horizon capabilities.
entries.evidence: Today, we're announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

entries.name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
entries.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weights speech model supporting promptable multilingual transcription, speaker attribution, and translation across 40 languages.
entries.evidence: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction.

entries.name: Prism
entries.summary: Rime launched Prism, a conversational speech-to-speech model responding in about 500ms with an inspectable text layer for running guardrails.
entries.evidence: Prism responds to user audio in about 500ms, faster than the most comparably intelligent model, with tool calls happening in parallel to speech, and an inspectable text layer to run guardrails over before the model speaks.

entries.name: Genie 4
entries.summary: Google announced Genie 4, a world model enabling real-time interactive environment simulations with native audio and natural language steering.
entries.evidence: Today, we're announcing our research on Genie 4, our new world model that brings unprecedented realism and native audio to real-time interactive simulation... With Genie 4, you can set an event in motion and steer scenes in real time using natural language

entries.name: Ling-3.1-flash-1019
entries.summary: An upgraded 560B open MoE model with 25B active parameters and 1M context, featuring improved reasoning and real-world agentic capabilities.
entries.evidence: We introduce Ling-3.1-flash-1019, an upgraded version of Ling-3.1-flash, with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters per token, and a 1M-token context window.

entries.name: LFM3
entries.summary: Liquid AI released LFM3, a family of six 2B-class open-weight models spanning text, vision, audio, and decision-making on edge devices.
entries.evidence: The first release is six 2B-class open-weight models — text, vision, audio, omni, and two decision models — all branched from a single LFM3-1.7B-Base backbone trained on 22T tokens. The headline change is a tri-hybrid architecture... carries a 256K-token context window

entries.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
entries.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, combining visual reasoning and computer use with 50% lower standard API prices.
entries.evidence: We're introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing... Its standard API prices are 50% lower than those of GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol

entries.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
entries.summary: MiniMax published open weights for M3.1 Flash, a 428B multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 23B active parameters and a 1M context window.
entries.evidence: Approximately 428B total; 23B activated per token; Inputs / output: Text, image, and video inputs; text output; Context window: Up to 1,000,000 tokens

entries.name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB
entries.summary: An open small language model optimized for conversational agents, fitting in about 4GB of memory with 64K context support.
entries.evidence: Today, we're excited to release Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB — our latest open small language model optimized for speed and intelligence per GB in conversational agents... 64k context: accommodate conversation history, instructions, tool definitions, retrieved information and application state

entries.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
entries.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, an updated multimodal reasoning model with a 1M context window and improved coding capabilities.
entries.evidence: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of Kimi K3, with substantially larger post-training compute... tool calling, and a 1M-token context window.

entries.name: Canva Craft
entries.summary: Canva's first in-house image foundation model, generating high-quality 2K resolution images across any aspect ratio via Canva and public API.
entries.evidence: Today, we're unveiling Canva Craft, our first state-of-the-art image generation model, developed and trained by Canva Research... Available now in Canva and to developers through our public API, Craft generates stunning, high-quality images at 2K resolution in any aspect ratio.

entries.name: Decisions API
entries.summary: A new API endpoint that returns quick typed answers, like a yes-or-no probability or a pick from fixed options, instead of free text.
entries.evidence: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API. It returns the probability a condition is true, a choice from a fixed set, or a score against a rubric.

entries.name: Rerank 5
entries.summary: Cohere launched Rerank 5 in Pro and Fast tiers, featuring Context Focus passage extraction and an expanded 32k context window.
entries.evidence: Two model variants available: rerank-v5.0-pro... rerank-v5.0-fast... Context Focus: An optional capability that returns the most relevant passages within each document... Extended context length: 32k token context window

entries.name: Claude Duet
entries.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, an app where Claude operates as a proactive personal agent across connected tools.
entries.evidence: Claude Duet is a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent. The research preview opens by waitlist today for Pro and Max subscribers in the US.

entries.name: Flint
entries.summary: Recursive introduced Flint, an open-weight 40B mixture-of-experts model activating 2.5B parameters per token for fast local coding agents.
entries.evidence: We're introducing Recursive Flint, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model built for fast agentic coding on local hardware. Flint has 40 billion total parameters and activates just 2.5 billion per token.

entries.name: Timestral
entries.summary: Mistral AI released Timestral, an open-weight foundation model family delivering zero-shot probabilistic forecasting for multivariate time series.
entries.evidence: Today, we're releasing Timestral, our first family of time-series foundation models. Our largest model, at just 209M parameters, ranks first on all three of the field's main public benchmarks

entries.name: Gemini 4 Argon
entries.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model delivering advanced performance in software engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise knowledge work.
entries.evidence: Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available to developers and enterprises via the Gemini API, and to Google AI subscribers in Google Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search.

entries.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
entries.summary: Anthropic calls it the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model it has released, at a much lower price than Haiku 4.5.
entries.evidence: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we have ever released. Haiku 5.5 is available at a much lower price than Haiku 4.5.

entries.name: Mistral Large 4
entries.summary: Mistral AI launched a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion parameter multimodal model with 52 billion active parameters.
entries.evidence: Today, we're launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4... ML4 is a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal model with 52 billion active parameters.

entries.name: Dots
entries.summary: OpenAI introduced Dots, persistent always-on AI agents in ChatGPT powered by GPT-6 Astra for long-running work.
entries.evidence: We're introducing dots: always-on agents in ChatGPT that can take on ongoing work and keep making progress between conversations. Powered by GPT-6 Astra

entries.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
entries.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Sol, bringing near-Astra intelligence for coding and computer use at one-fifth the token price.
entries.evidence: GPT-6.1 Sol is available starting today to all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex... at one-fifth of Astra's standard API input and output token prices.

entries.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
entries.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5, which runs over 30% faster and costs up to 30% less than Claude Sonnet 5.
entries.evidence: It's a clear upgrade over Claude Sonnet 5, runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work.

entries.name: Claude Opus 5.5
entries.summary: The first Claude 5.5 model performs at Fable 5.1 level on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
entries.evidence: It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5. Input and output tokens are $4 and $20 per million, 20% less than Opus 5.

entries.name: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
entries.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Sol and Luna, bringing frontier intelligence to everyday work with lower latency and reduced API pricing.
entries.evidence: GPT-6 Sol and Luna roll out today in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Both are also available in the API.

entries.name: Gemini 3.8 Live
entries.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and Extended Thinking to enable near real-time reasoning for voice agents.
entries.evidence: Today, we're introducing two new models that bring advancements in near real-time reasoning to more effectively enable voice agents and make conversing with AI feel more intuitive and intelligent. Gemini 3.8 Live... Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking

entries.name: GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, featuring frontier reasoning, coding, cybersecurity, and computer use capabilities.
entries.evidence: Introducing GPT-6 Astra, our most intelligent and aligned model yet, with state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science.
